messages:
maria: Quick heads up — during the v3.2 promote canary (fp16 -> int8) we saw a subtle quality divergence on long-doc summarization. Not huge but consistent on a few legal/contract slices. Opening thread to decide gating + auto-fallback thresholds. :eyes:
raj: Can you paste the delta numbers? p95 latency, MRR, and hallucination rate if available.
maria: TL;DR: MRR down ~1.7% vs fp16 on the long-doc slice (n=6.2k), overall product MRR -0.4% (n=52k). p95 latency +48ms on avg (small traffic spike accounted separately). Hallucination rate (classifier) +0.9% on that slice.
tim: n=6.2k is decent. For an auto-fallback rule we need both effect size and persistence window. I vote: trigger fallback if (MRR drop >= 1.5% AND sustained for 15m) OR (hallucination delta >= 1.0% with p<0.05).
sophia: Also ensure we protect legal/financial slices as hard gates, not just composite metrics. Those get a lower tolerance (MRR drop >= 0.8% -> immediate rollback for that slice).
raj: Agree. Add latency guard too: if p95 latency increases > 60ms for 10m -> fallback. Otherwise int8 can be noisy on long contexts.
maria: Deploy-bot shows canary id cny-2024-171980 started at 1719807200 — routing 5% traffic. I ran a quick split by prompt-length and long-docs (>= 2048 tokens) are the only cohort with consistent delta.
deploy-bot: canary cny-2024-171980 promoted: traffic=5% -> 5% at 1719807245. smoke-checks: pass=78/80 (two failing cases overlap long-doc slice).
tim: Let's add a sample-size requirement before auto-fallback: min 5k requests in the impacted slice within the window, otherwise mark as 'watch' but don't rollback automatically.
raj: Good call. Also add a margin-of-error check: require delta > 1.5 * stderr. Helps avoid tiny noisy flips.
sophia: Can someone drop a config snippet we can push to rollout policy? I'll copy to infra.
maria: Pasting proposed rollout policy patch (small):

```json
{"auto_fallback": {"global": {"mrr_drop_pct": 1.5, "persistence_mins": 15, "min_samples": 5000, "latency_p95_ms": 60}, "slices": {"legal": {"mrr_drop_pct": 0.8, "persistence_mins": 5, "immediate": true}}} }
```

maria: Note: we still keep the watch-only threshold at 0.5% MRR drop or any hallucination delta >0.4%. That will page the owners but not auto-rollback.
raj: I'll run a quick bootstrap on the long-doc slice with resampling to verify stderr numbers. Expect results in ~20m.
tim: Also enable shadow compare for the next 24h for this variant (no routing change) so we get more long-doc samples without user impact.
sophia: I'll update the console dashboards for the canary to highlight these slices and wire an alert to #incidents if slice-specific immediate gates trip.
maria: Ok actionable: (1) push the policy patch to staging, (2) enable 24h shadow run, (3) add long-doc slice to protected-gates, (4) raj runs bootstrap and posts numbers.
raj: On it. Will post results as a follow-up.
tim: :thumbsup: keep the promote paused until we validate.
maria: Thanks — if bootstrap confirms >1.5% persistent drop we rollback immediately. Otherwise proceed with 2->10% gradual promote with the new gates.
raj: preliminary bootstrap: MRR delta on long-docs = -1.9% (stderr 0.4%) after 25m sample. Filing a rollback if we don't see improvement in 5m.
maria: rolling back now per policy. deploy-bot, please execute canary rollback.
deploy-bot: rolling back canary cny-2024-171980 -> routing 5% -> 0% starting 1719810360. status: in-progress.
sophia: filing a short postmortem note and tagging legal for the slice repro steps.
mar ia: thanks team. follow-up: schedule a small eval harness for long-doc summarization with int8 quant artifacts and run targeted distillation tests.
